document.name: South Shore YMCA — Youth Swim Lessons
document.shortDescription: South Shore YMCA swim lessons for Staten Island kids, from parent-and-child water discovery through teen stages, with weekday, evening, and weekend availability.
document.longDescription:
The YMCA of Greater New York's South Shore branch publishes youth swim lessons at 3939 Richmond Avenue on Staten Island. Its current swimming page says the branch offers swim classes for infants, kids, teenagers, and adults, with weekday, evening, and weekend classes all year long.

The branch's current Programs and Classes page breaks those offerings into YMCA swim stages, including Parent and Child lessons for ages 6-36 months, Preschool lessons for ages 3-5, School Age Child lessons, and Teen lessons for ages 12-17. The page describes the parent-and-child pathway as adult-accompanied water readiness classes and explains that older children progress through safety, comfort, and stroke-development stages.

South Shore's branch pages describe the facility as a family-focused Staten Island YMCA with a pool and youth programming. The public camp page and branch listings provide the branch contact line 718-227-3200 and address 3939 Richmond Avenue, Staten Island, NY 10312, while the About page lists Aquatics Director Matthew Greenfield at mgreenfield@ymcanyc.org.

ClassScout's listing image reuses an official South Shore YMCA branch hero already uploaded to ImgBB from YMCA-hosted media.

Sources: https://ymcanyc.org/locations/south-shore-ymca/programs-classes/swimming https://ymcanyc.org/locations/south-shore-ymca/programs-and-classes https://ymcanyc.org/locations/south-shore-ymca/programs-classes/camps https://ymcanyc.org/locations/south-shore-ymca/about
